title: AI Provider Layer Tests
description: Create unit tests for 3 AI provider modules: (1) ai-provider-factory.test.ts covering 20+ provider type mappings (parameterized tests), OpenAI-compatible provider ID passing, unknown provider error handling, sanitizeConfigForLog sensitive key masking (apiKey, token, secret, password), maskSensitiveValue edge cases (short/long/non-string values), getAllProviders count; (2) abstract-provider-stub.test.ts covering 7 generation method variants (generateCommit with/without messages, generateCommitStream wrapper, generateCommitWithFunctionCalling tool formatting), and handleContextLengthError known/unknown pattern handling; (3) 2 model-registry tests (model-catalog-service.test.ts, model-validator.test.ts) for catalog sync and model validation.

criteria: 4 new test files created: [ai-provider-factory.test.ts, abstract-provider-stub.test.ts, model-catalog-service.test.ts, model-validator.test.ts] — verify by find src/ai -name '*.test.ts' | wc -l >= 5
ai-provider-factory covers all switch cases via parameterized tests — verify by grep 'test.each\|for.*provider' in factory test
Sensitive value masking covers 3 edge cases: [short string <=8 chars, long string >8 chars, non-string value] — verify by grep 'maskSensitive\|sanitize' in test
Abstract provider covers 7 generation method differences — verify by grep 'generateCommit\|generateStream\|FunctionCalling' in stub test
All tests pass — verify by npx vitest run src/ai (exit code 0)

rationale.why: Factory has 35+ switch cases (high regression risk for provider additions). Abstract provider covers 80%+ of all provider logic. ROI is good despite P2 priority.
rationale.approach: Create concrete MockAIProvider stub for abstract class testing. Use parameterized tests for factory switch cases. Focus on shared behavior in abstract class rather than individual thin wrappers.

risks.mitigation: Use DI helpers from IMPL-001; create minimal stub with only required methods
